assumptions: HMMER 3.4 hmmscan defaults unless changed: -E 10, --domE 10, --F1 0.02, --F2 1e-3, --F3 1e-5, bias filter and null2 on.
E-values are scaled by the number of models scanned, so a larger database makes every E-value larger.
limits: Answers only against the models given: an absent family is not an absent domain. A full Pfam-A scan needs the full Pfam-A file.
Reporting is by E-value; gathering cutoffs are reported beside each hit, not applied as --cut_ga would.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which of these profile HMMs does the protein carry, in which domains, with what E-values?

description: Which of MANY profile HMMs does this protein carry? Runs HMMER 3.4's hmmscan pipeline on this machine: the MSV, bias, Viterbi and Forward filters per model, domain definition by posterior decoding (several domains of one model are split, as hmmscan splits them), null2-corrected domain scores, and hmmscan's reporting thresholds.

E.description: hmmscan -E: report models with an E-value at or below this.

F1.description: hmmscan --F1: the MSV filter’s P-value threshold. Advanced.

F2.description: hmmscan --F2: the Viterbi filter’s P-value threshold. Advanced.

F3.description: hmmscan --F3: the Forward filter’s P-value threshold. Advanced.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alphabet.description: what the query is. `auto` reads them the way HMMER does (Easel’s composition rule). Set it when a short or unusual set is read wrongly: every DNA base is also an amino-acid letter, so a nucleotide set against a protein model scores without complaint and means nothing. Values: auto (Auto (Easel’s rule)), protein (Protein), nucleotide (Nucleotide). Advanced.

domE.description: hmmscan --domE: report domains with a conditional E-value at or below this.

pfam.description: Pfam accessions to fetch from InterPro and add to the database, comma-separated (PF00069,PF00017).

profiles.description: `.hmm` files to scan against, by name, from the project or the `_files` sent with the call; each may hold many models. Empty takes every `.hmm` there.

protein.description: the query protein, one-letter codes. Empty takes the open record when it is a protein.

name: hmmscan

Z.description: models scanned, which every E-value is scaled by

domains.description: the reported domains alone, in query order, each with its model name: the domain architecture

hits.description: every model that passed the pipeline, best first: model, accession, bits, evalue, reported, aboveGathering, and its domains (envFrom/envTo, aliFrom/aliTo on the query, hmmFrom/hmmTo, bits, iEvalue, cEvalue, reported, aboveGathering)
